summary: Calm 3D Iznik tile edge-matching puzzle, built by Claude Fable 5.1 · Sakin bir 3D İznik çinisi kenar eşleştirme bulmacası, Claude Fable 5.1 yaptı
key_features: 30 levels in 3 chapters: rotate tiles, then swap them, then fixed and double-sided tiles; boards grow from 3x3 to 6x6
Every level is generated solved and scrambled; the built-in solver solves all 30 levels and the daily boards
Moves against par for 1-3 stars, undo, three hints per level, a matched-edge counter and a daily board
A solved panel glazes, fires in the kiln and goes on the collection wall of the workshop
Puzzle-core tests under Node with no dependencies: node tests/core.test.mjs passes 345 of 345 checks

social.headline: Rotate, swap and flip Iznik tiles until every motif connects, then fire the panel · İznik çinilerini çevir, desenleri birleştir, panoyu fırında pişir

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README, index.html, tests/ and docs/assets.md; no field is generated from a guess
